```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = mpg, 
       mapping = aes(
         x = cty, y = hwy)
) + geom_point()

```

We also learned about the importance of clear labels using the lab function. Here is the graph with better labeling.

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = mpg, 
       mapping = aes(
         x = cty, y = hwy)
) + geom_point() + labs(title= "cty vs. hwy", x= "MPG on Highways", 
                        y= "MPG on City Roads")
```
